## The skill

What does it do, and when would someone use it?

## Checklist

- [ ] `java -jar tools/pbskill.jar check skills/<id>.pbskill` passes
- [ ] It reads only what it needs
- [ ] It has tests, including at least one `not` line
- [ ] The prompt describes the output and quotes no example sentence
- [ ] `version` is bumped if this updates an existing skill
- [ ] I tried it on my phone (optional, but say how it went)
